body.message:
I honestly don’t want to create any problems between us. I’m trying to avoid any issues.

Last month, I asked you to extend my stay for the month of August at the same rate, and you agreed. This is not my fault, to be honest. If you want me to leave after August, that’s absolutely fine.

However, I made my request in advance, and I have our WhatsApp conversation confirming your approval. I don’t believe I have done anything that goes against any rules.

Now, on the 28th of the month, you’re asking me either to leave immediately or pay a higher rate. I’m sorry, but I can’t accept that.

As agreed, August will be my last month, and I will pay the same rate that was previously approved. I have our WhatsApp conversation as confirmation of this agreement.
